title: Caelestia plugin manifest
description: metadata.json for a single plugin in the Caelestia community plugin store. Each plugin lives in its own folder under plugins/; the folder name is the plugin's immutable id.

id.description: Unique plugin id. Must equal the plugin folder name: lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens.

description.description: Short description shown in the store.

version.description: Semver version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, optionally with -prerelease and/or +build.

type.description: Kind of plugin. The set is extended by the maintainers as the shell gains capabilities.

author.description: Plugin author. Either a name string or an object with optional contact info.

license.description: SPDX license id for this plugin. Must match the LICENSE file in the plugin folder.

mediaurl.description: Optional media preview for the plugin. Accepts a web URL, an absolute local path, or a path relative to the plugin folder.

icon.description: Path to an icon file, relative to the plugin folder (e.g. icon.png).

screenshots.description: Paths to screenshot files, relative to the plugin folder.

homepage.description: Project homepage. Use a full URL with scheme.

repository.description: Source repository URL. Use a full URL with scheme.

shell-compat.description: Caelestia shell versions this plugin supports.

dependencies.description: Ids of other plugins this plugin depends on.

kpluginId.description: The KWin plugin id (X-KDE-PluginInfo-Name) this effect registers.

deprecated.description: true = keep serving to existing installs but stop recommending for new installs.

restart.description: Whether installing, removing, or toggling this plugin requires a shell restart.

replacement.description: Id of the plugin that replaces this one (used with deprecated: true).
